analyticsOrigin.text: Production `slop.cash` may load Cloudflare Web Analytics through Cloudflare's automatic setup, only to count page views by path and referring site. Cloudflare does not inject into HTML the site's Pages Function serves, so that function adds the same beacon tag on the production host only. The beacon uses no cookies or local storage, logs no query strings and reports to the site's own origin, so private Inbox, case and admin parameters never reach it. Staging, local development and tests never load it. No page depends on it: a blocked or failed beacon changes nothing. Add no other analytics or third-party script without a separate owner decision. The operator proposed this on 11 November 2026; the owner's merge approves it.

provisionalVault.text: The owner may fund a new EVM token vault before it is registered. Once the creation transaction is in a successful canonical block and matches the reviewed request, show the owner the funding form for that vault and state that the creation is not final. Register the vault only from a finalized creation. Count a deposit only from a finalized block and the vault's own deposit event, and only for a registered vault. If the block is replaced, withdraw the form and say so. A deposit confirmed while the vault was not on chain moved nothing; report it as failed, never as received or funded. Native-coin vaults, bounty vaults, other depositors, withdrawals, and Solana vaults wait for registration. Proposed by the operator on 14 November 2026; approved by the owner's merge.

customReferralCode.text: A signed-in member may choose a name for their own referral link (migration `0124_referral_codes.sql`, `backend/referrals/codes.ts`). `/referral/<name>` forwards to the project form with that member's GitHub login as the referrer. The name is only a pointer to the GitHub account: capture, the immutable record and accrual are unchanged. Refuse reserved names, another GitHub account's login, a name another account holds or has held, and administrator and moderator accounts. A member has one name in use, may replace it, and may hold five names in all; a replaced name stops forwarding and stays with its account. A name nobody has in use forwards to the form without a referrer. Settings shows the link and states no reward. The operator proposed this on 14 November 2026; the owner's merge approves it.
